result.summary: Analysis of the interface revealed two minor visual and logic discrepancies.

issues.description: A promotion badge displays '-0%', suggesting a logic error in the discount calculation.
issues.suggestion: Ensure badges only render for values greater than zero.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccolo' is truncated in the horizontal list.
issues.suggestion: Optimize text container width or implement multi-line labeling.
